Per capita plastic waste generation in the United States in 2019, with projections for 2030 and 2060
For 2030 the per capita consumption is

The United States produced 221 kilograms of plastic waste per capita in 2019 - roughly five times the global average. Plastics use in the U.S. is projected to increase considerably over the coming decades, which in turn will see plastic waste generation grow. By 2060, it is projected that the average U.S. inhabitant will produce 350 kilograms of plastic waste per year.
From global, the plastic consumption estimation will be about 5 times the global average.
